title: Oily Opulent Spanish Octopus Pulpo A La Gallega
description: A fresh and energizing Spanish dish featuring tender octopus, cheese slices, and score fat, perfect for a special occasion. This vegetarian-friendly version is a creative twist on the classic recipe.
instructions: Rinse the octopus under cold water and cut it into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the octopus pieces to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Arrange the cooked octopus on a platter and top with thinly sliced manchego cheese.
Serve the pulpo a la gallega hot, with lemon wedges on the side.
Drizzle the dish with a little extra olive oil, if desired.
